title: avoid-tool-call-message-when-no-tools
request: Hey, the ActionStep messages include a TOOL_CALL entry even when there are no tool calls (empty list). Can we suppress that message unless there are actual tool calls?
reference_diff:
--- a/src/smolagents/memory.py
+++ b/src/smolagents/memory.py
@@ -96,7 +96,7 @@
                 ChatMessage(role=MessageRole.ASSISTANT, content=[{"type": "text", "text": self.model_output.strip()}])
             )
 
-        if self.tool_calls is not None:
+        if self.tool_calls:
             messages.append(
                 ChatMessage(
                     role=MessageRole.TOOL_CALL,
test_diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_memory_tool_calls_message.py
@@ -0,0 +1,15 @@
+import pytest
+from smolagents.memory import ActionStep, ChatMessage, MessageRole, Timing
+
+def test_tool_calls_message_not_added_when_empty():
+    step = ActionStep(
+        step_number=1,
+        timing=Timing(start_time=0.0, end_time=1.0),
+        model_input_messages=[ChatMessage(role=MessageRole.USER, content="Hello")],
+        tool_calls=[],
+        model_output="Result",
+        model_output_message=ChatMessage(role=MessageRole.ASSISTANT, content="Result"),
+    )
+    msgs = step.to_messages()
+    # No TOOL_CALL message should be present when tool_calls is an empty list
+    assert all(m.role != MessageRole.TOOL_CALL for m in msgs)
